text: Amazon Web Services (AWS) is an Amazon.com company and one of the three segments through which Amazon.com, Inc. reports its operations.

source.name: Amazon.com, Inc. Form 10-K FY2025 (SEC EDGAR)
source.quote: We have organized our operations into three segments: North America, International, and Amazon Web Services (“AWS”).
